st_rae_definition: error = distance from prediction to nearest bound of ground-truth pIC50 credible interval; 0 if inside interval; RAE-normalised; macro-averaged over 4 endpoints

dataset_design.train: ~1500 12-point DRCs per CYP, Bayesian curve fit, BOTH arms -> sparse matrix
dataset_design.test: hit expansion: top 25 hits/CYP for CYP1A2+CYP2C9+CYP3A4 (75 parents) x top 10 ECFP4 Tanimoto chemisimilars from Enamine US in-stock = 750 cmpds, DENSE across all 4 CYPs
dataset_design.leaderboard_split: half test set live leaderboard, split BY CHEMISIMILAR SERIES (whole parent series stays in one side)

assays.CYP2D6: label-free Echo-MS (AEMS) dextromethorphan parent depletion, SCIEX ZenoTOF 7600
assays.tdi_design: IC50-shift: preincubation +/- NADPH before probe addition

submission_file.columns: case-sensitive exact match; all required and fully populated; pIC50 finite floats; TDI valid booleans

unannounced_in_blog: Space source config.py + models.py define a third track 'Structure Prediction' (pose), 184 structures, STRUCTURE_TRACK_LIVE=True, starts halfway through challenge
open_questions: exact ST-RAE normalisation denominator (trivial predictor definition) not published
credible interval width/level for test pIC50 not published (PXR used Bayesian DRC fits)
